race.comment: SALVE REGINA (3) has been edging towards an overdue maiden win, and she all but got the job done here 10 days ago when finishing runner-up by a nose. She faces a similar set-up, and from a slightly kinder gate, she can go one better. CHANDRA (12) makes her debut with 4 trials behind her, and she will draw the coveted pole position. The blinkers go on, and having Chris Parnham in the irons is a strong lead. Respect the market moves. HOLD MY WINE (1) has been off the scene for a while after a couple of modest efforts last December when well found in the market. He has won a recent trial very easily, and is set to show what he is made of. Follow your money. HARVEY'S WISH (9) only battled on debut, and she will don the blinkers for her second run off a freshen up. Her trial form prior to her only run was very promising, and she can finish a lot closer this time. FINITTO WEB (2) drops back into maiden company and can make amends for his modest last start effort in tougher company.
